host.name: Adobe Substance 3D Designer
host.official_executable: C:\Program Files\Adobe\Adobe Substance 3D Designer\Adobe Substance 3D Designer.exe

behavior: adds the adapter version-pinned site-packages directory to sys.path for the host process only
loads the exact receipted canonical plugin path with importlib.util.spec_from_file_location
registers the module under the diagnostic module name expected by the adapter
delegates initializeSDPlugin and uninitializeSDPlugin to the receipted plugin

invariants: The receipt and canonical plugin remain the source of truth; the shortcut loader is only a bootstrap shim.
Do not copy the canonical plugin into the Adobe profile as a second authority.
Do not set global PYTHONPATH or SBS_DESIGNER_PYTHON_PATH for this integration.
Revalidate the receipt hash before accepting any loader change.
